5.25pm An innings of two halves! Shubman Gill and B Sai Sudharsan both hit half-
centuries in a 120-run opening stand. That was at the 12-over mark. After that they 
managed just 60 runs in the next eight overs, losing six wickets. None of the batters 
after the openers could quite get in. Bishnoi, Rathi, Avesh and Shardul all bowled very 
impressively to keep GT down to 180. 
Sai Sudharsan: "It was difficult today, not coming on well, but me and Shubhi [Gill] had a 
lovely six overs of powerplay and that gave us momentum and gave us a good platform 
to finish good. The first few overs we didn't feel [the wicket would slow down], once the 
shine wore off the wicket started getting different. We had a conversation that the 
wicket could get slow but at the same time we didn't want to reduce our momentum 
and strike rate so it would be easier for us to finish well. Change of pace on the right 
areas were very difficult for the batters. A lot of balls are going low also and the slower 
ones are holding in the wicket. So it'll be difficult to bat on." 
Deepak Gupta: "As a Gooner I didn't like your comparison of CSK with Arsenal scoring 3 
against Real Madrid. Arteta has made Arsenal a European Giant whereas CSK is lost in 
its past glory. " Well, I meant for the comparison to mean that CSK this year are like 
Arsenal in the Emery years, and one day their Arteta era will come! 
Sonny : "I have no issues with the notebook celebration, it's no more confrontational 
than Sheldon Cottrell's salute or any number of others, as long as it isn't in the batters'
